cases.angle: DO NOT RETELL THE MURDERS. This is a follow-up for listeners who already heard the 2025 episode. Chapter 1 and ONLY chapter 1 recaps November 13 2022 in a few sentences: the King Road house, Ethan Chapin, Madison Mogen, Xana Kernodle, Kaylee Goncalves, the two surviving roommates, the knife-sheath DNA, the arrest. Chapters 2 through 12 cover ONLY what happened after the arrest and must not revisit the night of the murders: the capital case and the death-penalty filing, the defence motions and the DNA and cell-site fights, the June 30 2025 plea agreement, the July 2 2025 guilty plea to all five counts with appeals waived, the victim impact statements, the July 23 2025 sentencing to four consecutive life terms plus ten years, the gag order and released case files, and the July 2026 motion to withdraw the plea claiming ineffective counsel and coercion. He pleaded guilty and is serving life; he has moved to withdraw that plea and the court has not ruled.

cases.angle: A follow-up to the 2022 episodes, timed to the thirtieth anniversary in December 2026. ONE short chapter recapping December 26 1996, the ransom note, the 5:52 a.m. call and the discovery in the basement. The rest is the thirty years since and what has moved recently: the 2008 touch-DNA testing and the exoneration letter, the grand jury documents, Boulder Police's annual updates, and the department's December 2025 statement that it had conducted new interviews and re-tested evidence with current DNA technology. Nobody has ever been charged; name no suspects.

cases.title: The BTK Floppy Disk
cases.summary:
Welcome back to CrimeTimeSnacks, I'm Cory. Today we're looking at one of the most infamous cold cases in American history, the BTK killer. For decades, a phantom haunted Wichita, Kansas, binding and suffocating victims while sending taunting letters to the police and media.

But after going completely silent for thirteen years, the killer made a fatal mistake. He decided to reach out one more time, mailing items to law enforcement that would finally unravel his double life as a family man and security alarm installer. We'll trace the timeline from his chilling childhood fantasies to the digital footprint that brought him down.

cases.summary:
Hey everyone, Cory here. Today we are looking at a case that completely consumed the South Carolina Lowcountry. The Murdaugh family was a legal dynasty, but everything started to unravel on a June night in 2021 when Maggie and Paul Murdaugh were found dead near the dog kennels of their hunting lodge.

Alex Murdaugh claimed he was visiting his mother who had dementia when the murders happened. But as investigators dug deeper, cellphone data and a crucial video started telling a very different story. We are diving into the timeline, the botched crime scene, and the massive trial that followed.

cases.summary: In April 2026, Rex Heuermann was asked how he killed eight women. He gave the same one-word answer each time. Hey everyone, it's Cory. This time on CrimeTimeSnacks: the Gilgo Beach murders from the 911 call that started the search to the guilty plea that ended it. Who the women were, why the case stalled for a decade, the truck and the pizza crust that broke it, and what is still unanswered: Shannan Gilbert, the victim known as Asian Doe, and a mother and daughter whose case turned out to be something else.

On November 13, 2022, four University of Idaho students — Ethan Chapin, Madison Mogen, Xana Kernodle, and Kaylee Goncalves — were tragically murdered in their off-campus rental home in Moscow, Idaho. This episode unpacks the chilling events, the ongoing investigation, and the complexities surrounding the case.

He is convicted and appealing; say so, and do not treat the appeal as proof either way.

cases.title: The Menendez Brothers: The Parole Years
cases.summary:
Hey everyone, it's Cory. This time on CrimeTimeSnacks: what happened to Lyle and Erik Menendez after the verdict. Thirty years of appeals that went nowhere, the marriages inside prison walls, the TikTok generation that heard the abuse testimony differently, a letter found in a dresser, and a former Menudo member who came forward in 2023.

Then the part that is still moving: one district attorney who asked for resentencing and another who called their defense self-serving lies, the May 2025 ruling that cut their sentences to fifty years to life, the parole board that said no three months later, the judge who refused a new trial, and the early parole hearing now set for March 2027.

I covered the murders and the trials in an earlier episode, so this one tells 1989 once and spends its time on everything since.

cases.title: The Delphi Murder Case 2017
cases.summary: On February 14, 2017, the bodies of Abigail Williams (June 23, 2003 – February 13, 2017) and Liberty German (December 27, 2002 – February 13, 2017) were discovered near the Monon High Bridge Trail. The case has had no prominent suspects until recently. On October 28th police announced they had made an arrest in the case. A 50 year old Delphi Resident was arrested and charged with two felony counts of murder. Listen while we dive into the case starting over 5 years ago in on a beautiful hiking trail.

cases.title: The Miami Apartment Stabbing
cases.summary: Courtney Clenney was arrested on August 10, 2022. She pleaded guilty on August 10, 2026. Four years, to the day, and the case still did not answer its own question. Hey everyone, it's Cory. This time on CrimeTimeSnacks: the killing of Christian Obumseli in a Miami high-rise. The fourteen minutes on April 3, 2022, the elevator video, the medical examiner's finding that broke the self-defense account, the four months before an arrest, the battered spouse defense that never reached a jury, and what a plea leaves unsettled. If any of this sounds like your life, the National Domestic Violence Hotline is 800-799-7233.

cases.title: The Interrogation of Chris Watts
cases.summary: Hey everyone, it's Cory. This time on CrimeTimeSnacks: the forty-eight hours in which Chris Watts's story came apart on camera. A friend who would not leave a doorstep, a patrol officer who noticed a husband was too calm, a neighbor's security camera, an FBI agent who held back his best evidence, a polygraph score of negative 18, and the way out that investigators offered him. Where the published accounts disagree, I say so. From the welfare check on August 13, 2018 to the oil site at 11 that night two days later, then the plea, the sentence, and the versions of the story he has told since.

cases.title: Watts Family Murders
cases.summary: The Watts family murders occurred in August 2018 in Frederick, Colorado. Chris Watts, the father, killed his pregnant wife, Shanann, and their two young daughters, Bella and Celeste. The crime gained significant media attention due to its horrific nature and the subsequent investigation. Watts initially denied involvement but later confessed to the murders. He was sentenced to life in prison without the possibility of parole. The case continues to be a source of fascination and discussion for true crime enthusiasts.

cases.title: JonBenét Ramsey
cases.summary: JonBenét Patricia Ramsey was murdered. That is the only certain thing about this case after 26 years. There is key evidence in this case, as well as more theories than there are people involved. I took weeks of research and broke it down into a two-part segment where I go over all the facts known in the case today, as well as some key suspects. I try to stay away from the theories that have little to no factual basis. Listen to the facts of the case and form your own opinion. Visit CrimeTimeSnacks.com to stay even more involved and join an ever-growing true crime community. -@CrimeTimeSnacks

cases.title: JonBenét Ramsey Americas Child Beauty Queen
cases.summary: In Boulder, Colorado, just a day after Christmas in 1996, JonBenét Ramsey, a six-year-old child pageant star, was found dead in her basement. She had been beaten and strangled. That was hours after her parents, John and Patsy, reported her missing, and hours after her mom found a ransom note on a staircase in the house. Nobody has ever been convicted in this case, even 26 years later. This is the lead-in to a two-part special where we go back to Christmas 1996 and look again at all the facts in this case.

updates.title: California parole board grants Erik and Lyle Menendez early parole hearing
updates.summary: The California Board of Parole has granted Erik and Lyle Menendez an early parole hearing scheduled for March 2027. The hearing was advanced from its previously scheduled date of August 2028.

updates.title: State accuses Murdaugh defense of falsehoods regarding phone data
updates.summary: South Carolina prosecutors filed a response accusing Alex Murdaugh's defense of 'brazen falsehoods' in their motion seeking raw cellphone extraction files. The state maintained that the requested digital evidence had already been provided to the defense multiple times prior to the original trial.

updates.title: Prosecutors dispute Murdaugh defense claims on cell phone data
updates.summary: State prosecutors asked Judge Debra R. McCaslin to deny Alex Murdaugh's motion to compel cellphone extraction files ahead of his 2027 retrial. The state argued that the unredacted raw files were already turned over multiple times before his first trial.

updates.title: Prosecutors push back on Murdaugh defense cellphone data demands
updates.summary: South Carolina prosecutors filed court documents criticizing Alex Murdaugh's defense for false assertions regarding missing cellphone data. Judge Debra McCaslin scheduled an October 16 hearing in Lexington County to address pretrial disputes.

updates.title: Prosecutors push back against Alex Murdaugh's cellphone data claims in court filing
updates.summary: Prosecutors filed court papers in Colleton County criticizing defense claims regarding missing cellphone data as false and outlining prior discovery disclosures. Judge Debra McCaslin scheduled a pretrial hearing for October 16 at the Lexington County courthouse ahead of an April 5 retrial in Sumter County.

updates.title: Prosecutors oppose Murdaugh motion over cellphone files
updates.summary: South Carolina prosecutors filed a response asking the judge to deny Alex Murdaugh's motion to compel underlying cellphone extraction files. The state maintained that complete extraction files were provided to defense experts multiple times prior to the 2023 trial.

updates.title: State opposes Murdaugh motion to compel cell evidence
updates.summary: South Carolina prosecutors filed a response asking Judge Debra McCaslin to deny Alex Murdaugh's motion to compel cellphone extraction files, stating the defense was already provided all raw data in 2022. The state accused the defense of brazen falsehoods ahead of an October 16, 2026 hearing.

updates.title: South Carolina prosecutors urge judge to deny Murdaugh cellphone data request
updates.summary: In a Monday court filing, the state asked a judge to deny Alex Murdaugh's motion for additional cellphone data, stating all records were already produced. Judge Debra McCaslin scheduled an in-person evidentiary hearing for October 16 ahead of the April 5, 2027 retrial.

updates.title: Hearing set for October 16 on Murdaugh defense motions
updates.summary: Circuit Court Judge Debra McCaslin scheduled a defense motions hearing and status conference for October 16, 2026, to address disputes over alleged withheld discovery. The proceeding follows multiple defense motions filed in September seeking cellphone extractions, DNA, ballistics, and scene data.

updates.title: Ex-fiancée of Golden State Killer gives first media interview
updates.summary: Bonnie Ueltzen gave her first media interview in the docuseries "The Golden State Killer: Unmasking A Monster," recounting an incident where Joseph DeAngelo appeared outside her home with a gun after she broke off their engagement. She expressed regret over never reporting the confrontation to police.

updates.title: Judge schedules October 16 evidentiary hearing in Murdaugh retrial
updates.summary: Judge Debra McCaslin scheduled an in-person hearing for October 16, 2026, to address urgent evidentiary disputes concerning DNA, cell phone data, ballistics, and FARO scans ahead of Alex Murdaugh's retrial. Prosecutors were ordered to submit their responses to pending motions by October 8.

updates.title: Murdaugh defense asks judge to compel evidence production
updates.summary: Alex Murdaugh's defense attorney Dick Harpootlian sent a letter to Circuit Court Judge Debra McCaslin urging the court to force prosecutors to produce outstanding discovery materials. Harpootlian noted that three motions to compel remain pending and the state has produced almost nothing ahead of the April 2027 retrial.

updates.title: Fox Nation releases documentary series re-examining Golden State Killer timeline
updates.summary: Fox Nation launched a four-part docuseries, "Golden State Killer: Unmasking a Monster," exploring whether Joseph DeAngelo committed crimes earlier than previously known and left additional victims. The series features new accounts from survivors and re-examines unsolved cases.

updates.title: Indiana Court of Appeals hears appeal in Richard Allen's Delphi murder conviction
updates.summary: The Indiana Court of Appeals heard oral arguments regarding whether Richard Allen received a fair trial in his 2024 double murder conviction. Defense attorneys argued that key evidence was suppressed at trial, including evidence of other possible suspects and Allen's mental state when he confessed.

updates.title: Indiana Court of Appeals hears oral arguments in Richard Allen appeal
updates.summary: A three-judge panel of the Indiana Court of Appeals heard oral arguments regarding whether Richard Allen received a fair trial in his 2024 murder conviction. Allen's defense argued that evidence pointing to other suspects was suppressed and that his mental state during his confessions while in solitary confinement was not fully presented to jurors.

updates.title: Indiana appellate judges question state over Richard Allen's pretrial confinement
updates.summary: The Indiana Court of Appeals heard oral arguments on Richard Allen's appeal seeking a new trial. Allen's defense argued his pretrial solitary confinement drove him into psychosis to extract confessions, leading appellate judges to question the state's treatment of Allen prior to trial.

updates.title: Indiana appellate judges hear oral arguments in Richard Allen's Delphi murders appeal
updates.summary: A three-judge panel of the Indiana Court of Appeals heard arguments regarding whether Richard Allen received a fair trial in the 2017 Delphi murders. Allen's defense challenged the admissibility of his confessions and search evidence, while the state defended his conviction.

updates.title: Indiana appeals court hears Richard Allen's challenge to 130-year sentence
updates.summary: The Indiana Court of Appeals held a hearing where Richard Allen's attorney argued that solitary confinement induced psychosis leading to false confessions, seeking to overturn his conviction.

updates.title: Bryan Kohberger files petition to withdraw guilty plea
updates.summary: Bryan Kohberger filed a handwritten motion seeking to withdraw his guilty plea for the 2022 Moscow murders, claiming coercion, threats, and ineffective assistance from his defense team.

updates.title: Bryan Kohberger files motion to withdraw guilty plea
updates.summary: Bryan Kohberger has filed a handwritten motion seeking to withdraw his guilty plea, alleging coercion, threats, and ineffective counsel from his defense team. He is requesting to reopen the case and proceed to trial.

updates.title: Hearing scheduled for October 15 on motion to remove Judge Hippler in Kohberger case
updates.summary: Bryan Kohberger is scheduled to return to court on October 15 for a hearing regarding his legal team's efforts to disqualify Judge Steven Hippler from his post-conviction proceedings.

updates.title: Murdaugh defense files motion to compel DNA, ballistics, and scan data
updates.summary: Attorneys for Alex Murdaugh filed a motion asking a judge to order prosecutors to turn over additional DNA testing, ballistics records, and raw FARO crime scene scan data. The defense requested the production of materials ahead of an expected November hearing and the April 2027 retrial.

updates.title: Idaho Supreme Court sets oral arguments on Lori Vallow Daybell appeal
updates.summary: The Idaho Supreme Court is scheduled to hear oral arguments on Lori Vallow Daybell's appeal on November 2. Her appeal centers on the claim that her hired attorney was unconstitutionally removed over a conflict of interest.

updates.title: Menendez brothers' next parole hearings scheduled for February 2027
updates.summary: The California Board of Parole tentatively scheduled Lyle Menendez's parole hearing for February 23, 2027, and Erik Menendez's hearing for February 24, 2027, moving up their hearings under Proposition 9.

updates.title: Menendez brothers' next parole hearings tentatively set for February 2027
updates.summary: The California Board of Parole tentatively scheduled Lyle Menendez's next hearing for February 23, 2027, and Erik Menendez's for February 24, 2027, advancing their dates under Proposition 9.

updates.title: Menendez brothers' parole hearings scheduled for February 2027
updates.summary: Lyle and Erik Menendez have had their next parole hearings tentatively scheduled for February 23 and February 24, 2027, respectively. The advanced hearings were granted by the California Board of Parole under provisions of Proposition 9.

updates.title: Netflix schedules premiere date for The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey limited series
updates.summary: Netflix announced that its upcoming limited series, "The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey" starring Melissa McCarthy and Clive Owen, will premiere globally on December 10, 2026.

updates.title: Netflix sets December 10 premiere for 'The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey'
updates.summary: Netflix announced that its limited series 'The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey' will premiere on December 10.

updates.title: Netflix sets December 10 release date for 'The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey'
updates.summary: Netflix announced that its limited series 'The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey', starring Melissa McCarthy and Clive Owen, will premiere on December 10.

updates.title: Rex Heuermann disciplined after drugs found under his prison bed
updates.summary: Rex Heuermann was placed in an isolated cellblock and had privileges restricted after officers at Clinton Correctional Facility found synthetic marijuana hidden under his bed. A disciplinary hearing concluded on August 18 following the discovery.

updates.title: Rex Heuermann disciplined in prison after synthetic marijuana paper found in cell
updates.summary: Convicted Gilgo Beach serial killer Rex Heuermann was disciplined at Clinton Correctional Facility after guards discovered paper soaked in synthetic marijuana in his cell. Heuermann was moved to an isolated cellblock and temporarily had his mail privileges suspended.

updates.title: Oral arguments anticipated in Petito family lawsuit against Utah police
updates.summary: Attorneys representing Gabby Petito's family expect oral arguments soon in their lawsuit alleging a Utah police department failed to prevent her murder.

updates.title: Parole board advances Menendez brothers' parole hearing to March 2027
updates.summary: The Menendez brothers have been granted an early parole suitability hearing tentatively scheduled for March 2027, advancing it from August 2028. Both brothers were resentenced to 50 years to life in May 2025 before being denied parole later that year.

updates.title: Menendez brothers granted early parole hearing for March 2027
updates.summary: Erik and Lyle Menendez were granted an early parole suitability hearing tentatively scheduled for March 2027. They were previously not eligible to seek a hearing until August 2028.

updates.title: Menendez brothers granted early parole hearing for March 2027
updates.summary: Lyle and Erik Menendez have been granted an advanced parole hearing tentatively scheduled for March 2027, over a year earlier than previously anticipated.

updates.title: Former CBI DNA analyst Yvonne Woods sentenced to 10 years in prison
updates.summary: Former Colorado Bureau of Investigation DNA analyst Yvonne 'Missy' Woods was sentenced to 10 years in prison after pleading guilty to tampering with evidence in over 1,000 cases. Her conviction has prompted renewed scrutiny of DNA evidence handled during the JonBenét Ramsey investigation.

updates.title: Erik and Lyle Menendez granted early parole suitability hearings
updates.summary: The California parole board granted requests by Erik and Lyle Menendez to advance their parole suitability hearings to March, roughly 17 months earlier than expected.

updates.title: Parole board advances Menendez brothers' hearings to March
updates.summary: The California parole board approved requests by Erik and Lyle Menendez to advance their parole suitability hearings to March, approximately 17 months earlier than scheduled. The decision followed their previous parole denial in August 2025.

updates.title: Judge sets schedule for Murdaugh dismissal motion
updates.summary: During an August 14 pretrial hearing, Judge Debra McCaslin set a schedule for arguments on Alex Murdaugh's motion to dismiss murder charges over alleged fabricated grand jury testimony, scheduling a hearing for November 13.

updates.title: Utah Supreme Court sets hearing for Petito wrongful death lawsuit
updates.summary: The Utah Supreme Court scheduled oral arguments for March 4 in the wrongful death lawsuit brought by Gabby Petito's parents against Moab police.

updates.title: Judge Dismisses $50M Wrongful Death Lawsuit Against Moab Police
updates.summary: A Utah judge dismissed the Petito family's $50 million wrongful death lawsuit against the Moab Police Department, citing the state's Governmental Immunity Act.
